projects.title: Agentic AI Machine Learning Pipeline for Big Data Analytics
body: An end-to-end agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and PySpark to automate data analysis, feature engineering, and model training.
Implemented with human-in-the-loop review gates and automated quality checks.

projects.title: Twitter Bot Detection Model
projects.body: A Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN) developed from a heterogeneous user-to-user graph constructed from a representative subgraph of 40k users and engineered relation types from raw Twitter interaction data.
